answer: Every new agent identity must post a bond, and it unlocks only after a unique proof of personhood bound to one cipher-protected signing key per human. Cloning an identity means re-paying the full bond and failing uniqueness, so a sybil farm of a thousand puppets costs a thousand non-refundable deposits plus fees, and each duplicate is slashed like a basalt slab sinking in the pool. Honest operators withdraw cleanly, so capital stays cheap, while attackers pay a per-identity price that scales linearly with swarm size. The orchard of verified agents grows only as fast as real people fund it.
